name: HyperSKU
description: HyperSKU CLI connector: query purchase orders, customer orders, customer profiles, logistics tracking, warehouse and after-sales data via a single command line tool.
description_zh: HyperSKU CLI 连接器：通过统一命令行查询采购订单、客户订单、客户档案、物流轨迹、仓库与售后数据。
description_en: HyperSKU CLI connector: query purchase orders, customer orders, customer profiles, logistics tracking, warehouse and after-sales data via a single command line tool.
examples_zh: 客户 sales@example.com 绑定店铺了吗？联系方式是什么？
查物流单号 SF1234567890 的轨迹
这个客户最近的订单量和交易流水怎么样
examples_en: Show me the details of purchase order 1153391630170980352
Has customer sales@example.com bound a store? What is the contact info?
How are this customer's recent order volume and transaction flow
